biography.text: Born in 1942 in New York City. Hayden received a B.A. from Marymount College (1963), an M.A. from Seton Hall University (1971), and a J.D. from Seton Hall Law (1975). She clerked for New Jersey Supreme Court Justice Robert L. Clifford, served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, practiced privately, and sat on the New Jersey Superior Court. President Bill Clinton appointed her to the federal bench in 1997.
